notice: Illustrative archetypes for testing the generator. They are not HPCI recommendations and have not passed evidence or recommendation gates.

scenarios.title_ja: バランス型・連合共通基盤
scenarios.objective: 汎用CPUとアクセラレータを組み合わせ、共通運用・データ基盤で幅広い既存利用者とAI需要を支える。

architecture.memory_network: balanced HBM/DDR and interoperable scale-out fabric
architecture.storage_facility: local scratch plus shared data services within site constraints

system_software.execution: Slurm-centered batch with containers and portals
system_software.federation: common identity, transfer, telemetry, and metadata interfaces

applications.portfolio: broad simulation and AI for Science

center_impacts.fit: high if local demand remains broad
medium; may need larger accelerator share
center_impacts.migration: reuse common software and data plane

technology_options.candidate: worldwide CPU, interconnect, and software candidates
technology_options.role: qualified partitions or staged subsystems; Japan-origin candidates receive priority coverage under the same gates
technology_options.maturity_gate: application performance, production, support, and software readiness

uncertainties: Current center profiles are not yet accepted

scenarios.title_ja: AI・データ集約型重点整備
scenarios.objective: 大規模AI、AI for Science、実験データ処理を中心に高密度アクセラレータとデータプレーンを重点整備する。

architecture.compute: high-density accelerator nodes plus large-memory service nodes
architecture.memory_network: high-bandwidth memory and high-bisection accelerator fabric
architecture.storage_facility: high-throughput ingest, object/metadata services, and accelerated scratch

system_software.execution: batch plus Kubernetes and high-throughput inference
system_software.portability: framework-first environment with validated HPC paths
system_software.federation: experiment streaming, model/data governance, and secure external access

applications.portfolio: AI for Science, LLM training/inference, digital twins
applications.evaluation: topology, memory, I/O, energy, and end-to-end science metrics

center_impacts.fit: high where power and data infrastructure permit
conditional; CPU capacity may be insufficient

technology_options.candidate: worldwide AI accelerators, storage software, and optical/network technologies
technology_options.role: evaluation and production pilot lane; Japan-origin candidates receive priority coverage under the same gates
technology_options.maturity_gate: framework compatibility, sustained performance, power, scale, and support

scenarios.title_ja: 新技術評価・段階導入型
scenarios.objective: 世界のCPU、アクセラレータ、量子・Ising、ソフトウェア等を実証から本番へ段階導入し、供給・人材・産業波及を含めて評価する。

architecture.compute: production core plus domestic-technology qualification partitions

system_software.execution: common scheduler and container contract across pilot and production
system_software.portability: domestic compiler/runtime work tied to upstream and application teams
system_software.federation: cross-center testbed, benchmark, provenance, and support service

applications.portfolio: applications selected for domestic technology advantage
applications.service: pilot, early access, and production gates
applications.evaluation: performance, power, correctness, productivity, production, and maintenance

center_impacts.center_group: centers with co-design and engineering capacity
center_impacts.migration: requires dedicated porting and support teams

technology_options.candidate: worldwide CPU, vector, dataflow, RISC-V, quantum/Ising, packaging, and software portfolio
technology_options.role: research and stage-gated deployment portfolio; Japan-origin candidates receive priority coverage under the same gates
technology_options.maturity_gate: independent benchmark, production capacity, lifecycle support, and application adoption
technology_options.fallback: compatible production subsystem with preserved APIs and data services

decision_gates: Complete independent benchmark and support review

scenarios.title_ja: センター特化・全国ポートフォリオ型
scenarios.objective: 各センターの利用者、設備、地域、更新時期に応じて役割を分担し、HPCI全体として補完的な資源ポートフォリオを形成する。

architecture.compute: center-specific capability, capacity, AI/data, and emerging-technology roles
architecture.memory_network: role-specific node designs connected by national data and access services
architecture.storage_facility: hybrid local/shared tiers with lifecycle decoupled from compute

system_software.execution: federated resource catalog, allocation, meta-scheduling, and urgent jobs
system_software.portability: common minimum environment plus center extensions
system_software.federation: identity, metadata, transfer, monitoring, and user support

applications.portfolio: national coverage assembled from center specialties
applications.evaluation: coverage gaps, transfer cost, queue balance, and migration

technology_options.candidate: worldwide technologies matched to qualified center roles
technology_options.role: national testbed and selected production services; Japan-origin candidates receive priority coverage under the same gates
technology_options.maturity_gate: center-specific application, facility, operations, and support fit

decision_gates: Accept current profiles for every center
